How to Apply
content_sections.text: Candidates who wish to apply for NBRC Account Assistant Recruitment 2026 via email should follow the steps below. Read the official notification carefully before applying. Prepare your application with complete bio-data including personal details, educational qualifications, and experience. Attach self-attested copies of all required documents such as educational certificates, experience certificates, ID proof, and recent passport-size photographs. Clearly mention the post applied for in the subject line of the email. Send the complete application to the official email address mentioned in the notification. Ensure the email is sent before the last date: 07-09-2026. Keep a copy of the sent email for future reference.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the NBRC Account Assistant position?
faq.answer: The last date to submit your application via email for the NBRC Account Assistant recruitment is 07 September 2026.

faq.question: Q2. What is the educational qualification required for the Account Assistant post?
faq.answer: Candidates must possess a Bachelor's degree in Accounting, Finance, or Commerce (B.Com) to be eligible for the Account Assistant position.

faq.question: Q3. What is the age limit for the Account Assistant role?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit for the Account Assistant position is 30 years.

faq.question: Q4. What is the salary offered for the Account Assistant position?
faq.answer: The selected candidate for the Account Assistant post will receive a consolidated salary of Rs. 30,000 per month.

faq.question: Q5. How many vacancies are available for the Account Assistant post?
faq.answer: There is one vacancy available for the Account Assistant position at the National Brain Research Centre.

faq.question: Q6. What is the application mode for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Applications for the NBRC Account Assistant recruitment must be submitted via Email.

faq.question: Q7. Is there any application fee for the NBRC Account Assistant recruitment?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee mentioned for any category (General/OBC, SC/ST) for this recruitment.

faq.question: Q8. What is the selection process for the Account Assistant role?
faq.answer: The selection process for the Account Assistant position will be based on an Open Interview.

faq.question: Q9. Where is the National Brain Research Centre located?
faq.answer: The National Brain Research Centre is located in Manesar, Haryana, with the pincode 122052.

faq.question: Q10. Is this a permanent or contract job?
faq.answer: The Account Assistant position at NBRC is a contract-based job.
